$comment: GitHub usernames mapped to whether they are a trusted author. Read by tools/build_catalog.py: an entry is trusted when its "author" field exactly matches a key here (case-sensitive) with value true. A false entry is a deliberate record that an author was reviewed and NOT (yet) trusted, distinct from never having been reviewed at all - every author currently in the catalog was seeded here at false during the migration to this whitelist system, none pre-approved. A PR adding a new catalog entry must add its author here too (true or false) before it can be merged - see the trusted-authors-check workflow.
